attributes.additional_details: Keir Starmer has resigned and only a General Electric is a fair way to decide who should run this Country
attributes.background: The UK should be entitled to a General Election now Keir Starmer has Resigned after Failing to deliver what the people of this country Voted for and a General Election is the only fair result in this matter to let the people if this country decide who they want to run the government
